title: Choose Unprompted's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Pairings Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Pairings Sheet
options.lineage: Pokémon TCG organized play: Swiss standings boards, pairings sheets taped to a wall, table placards, top-cut brackets, match slips
options.thesis: Brands are not scored, they are placed. The machine is the judge; Unprompted only keeps the sheet.
options.viewport: This week's standings: numbered placements down the page, brand names in tall condensed type, rotation as a placement figure, movement arrows in the margin, and The Snub called out as a dropped placement.
options.risk: Standings language could read as Unprompted passing judgement, when the whole product principle is that it only reports what machines said.

options.label: Swiss Grid Poster Wall
options.lineage: Swiss International Style concert-poster series, one modular grid across twelve pieces
options.thesis: One grid disciplines every week; each edition differs by geometry, never by layout.
options.case: Strongest challenger on product clarity: objective, calm, built for dense data. Weakest on audience identification, because it could be any data publication in any category.

options.label: Used-Future Crew Terminal
options.lineage: Working starship terminal: green and amber phosphor on curved CRT, stencilled equipment codes, hazard plates
options.thesis: You key a query and the glass answers in typed capitals, one line at a time.
options.case: The query-and-answer grammar flatters the name Unprompted. But it fights the mobile-first brief on legibility, and the CRT costume is the literal reading of the name, which is the rut rather than an escape from it.

options.label: Tokonoma Alcove
options.lineage: Ikebana in a tokonoma: asymmetric line, seasonal material, and charged empty space
options.thesis: Meaning carried by line and by the emptiness deliberately left around it.
options.case: Fuses poorly. Active emptiness is the opposite of what a dense weekly standings table needs, and a hobbyist screenshotting a number into an argument is not served by ma.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The analytics dashboard every AI-visibility tool ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Dark navy ground, card grid, a line chart hero, one accent gradient, clean sans throughout.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Profound, Peec and Otterly, which is the exact comparison this product exists to escape.
